directive:
Revise the proposal without changing its flagship kernel: retain the exact uniform-law adjacent-score variance/noise–geometry phase transition, the K_n-growing corrected-risk expansion, the studentized multiplier band, and the locally honest unresolved-resolution profile.

Repair all primitive notation and quantifiers consistently. Use P^(n) for the population law in row n and P_emp,n for the empirical measure of O_{n,1},…,O_{n,n} iid from P^(n); never define the triangular class by P=P_n. Rewrite the class, assumptions, scores, probabilities, suprema, witness membership, and theorem statements with this distinction. State the band condition uniformly as sup over P^(n) in the triangular causal-quantizer class of Gamma_n(P^(n)) tending to zero (or an explicitly equivalent uniform condition), rather than fixing P and then taking a supremum over P.

For an ordered codebook C_{P,K}={c_{P,K,1}<⋯<c_{P,K,K}}, introduce the Voronoi-boundary set B_{P,K}={ (c_{P,K,j}+c_{P,K,j+1})/2 : 1≤j<K }. Use dist(b_P(X),B_{P,K}) in the margin condition; set B_{P,1}=∅ and state dist(u,∅)=+∞. Do not use ∂C_{P,K} for a finite set.

Add explicit nondegeneracy assumptions before every ratio or studentized definition: W_{P^(n)}(1)>0 and σ_{P^(n),K}>0 for every 1≤K<K_n. For uniform ratio inference, either impose a fixed uniform lower bound on W_{P^(n)}(1) over the triangular causal-quantizer class or explicitly track inverse-W(1) factors in the remainder/frontier; mere pointwise positivity is insufficient if W(1) may vanish across the triangular class. Define B_n, d_n, Γ_n, T_n, T_n^#, and the band only on this nondegenerate class.

Correct the indexing and ratio expansion: prove the optimized-risk expansion for every 1≤K≤K_n, since G_P(K_n−1) uses W_P(K_n). Replace the current profile remainder by an adjacent remainder that controls the W_K and W_{K+1} remainders, the W_1 denominator remainder, and the quadratic ratio term, with the appropriate W_P(1) factors; define Γ_n from this actual standardized adjacent-profile remainder. Propagate this correction through the band theorem and the uniform-witness reduction.

Add a transparent sufficient-growth corollary by naming uniform polynomial exponents for curvature, cell radius, margin constants/radius, nuisance rate, score envelope, W(1), and adjacent variance, substituting them into the corrected Γ_n, and deriving an explicit admissible ceiling for K_n. Compare that ceiling with fixed-K theory and with both ν_nK=O(1) and ν_nK→∞ regimes of the uniform witness.

Strengthen the converse lane by specifying one explicit nondegenerate causal subfamily for the mass-preserving adjacent-score transport and promoting it to a concrete lower-bound theorem target or sharply stated conjecture identifying a necessary resolution exponent or a necessary component of Γ_n. Do not assert necessity beyond what that subfamily supports.

Rebase C_{P,K} on the compact space of ordered tuples 0≤c₁≤⋯≤c_K≤1, and replace ass:unique-codebooks plus ass:interior-codebooks by one proposal-specific assumption that the optimizer set is a singleton whose coordinates satisfy 0<c₁<⋯<c_K<1. Retag curvature and the arbitrary-exponent, resolution-dependent margin condition as novel growing-K regularity assumptions, citing Pollard and Levrard only as fixed-K antecedents rather than as exact standard provenance. Do not delete ass:bounded-feature; rewrite it transparently as |μ₁,P(x)−μ₀,P(x)|≤1 a.s., which is equivalent to b_P(X)∈[0,1] under the present scaling. Update the class membership and dependency lists accordingly, while leaving Γ_n, the growing-risk expansion, multiplier band, and adjacent lower-bound kernel unchanged. Make the exact uniform witness explicitly verify the consolidated optimizer assumption. Treat a broader sufficient-distributional route and a named learner attaining r_n as later strengthening work, not D-1.2 prerequisites.

Make only the following hygiene edits; preserve every flagship theorem, witness, lower bound, and open question, and do not undertake the Assouad/Le Cam-chain strengthening.

(1) For each training fold define \(\widehat e^{\mathrm{cl}}(x)=\min\{1-\epsilon/2,\max(\epsilon/2,\widehat e(x))\}\), and replace \(\widehat e\) by \(\widehat e^{\mathrm{cl}}\) everywhere in the corrected losses, estimated influence scores, variance estimates, and multiplier bootstrap. Do not add an independent fitted-overlap crux.

(2) In ass:resolution-denominator replace the erroneous standard/Belloni provenance by novel: {flag: true, justification: ...} explaining exactly that \(W_P(1)=\inf_{c\in[0,1]}E\{b_P(X)-c\}^2=\operatorname{Var}\{b_P(X)\}\); hence \(W_P(1)\ge\underline w\) is the proposal-specific nonvanishing causal-heterogeneity regime needed to define and uniformly linearize the normalized ratio profile, excludes homogeneous/drifting-to-homogeneous laws, and is nonempty because the uniform witness has \(W(1)=1/12\). Belloni et al. may remain cited only for supplied-score simultaneous inference.

(3) Replace the thin KimKimKennedy2026 comparison consistently in Theorem 1, its gap/justification, comparator table, related_work, honest_scope, and checklist by the precise corroborating-preprint locator: arXiv:2405.03083v5, §4.1 eq. (10) and Lemma 4.1 for the fixed-k optimal-risk influence function; §4.2 Assumptions A4–A6 and Lemma 4.2 for fixed-codebook corrected-risk root-n normality; and Remark 3.1 for the explicit statement that k is fixed and k-selection/increasing k is not addressed. Use the final ordinary revision on angle 0 to make the paper honest and survey-complete; do not attempt comparator inflation or claim a generic theorem unsupported by the present primitives.

Add Kim, Kim, Wasserman, and Kennedy (NeurIPS 2024), Hierarchical and Density-based Causal Clustering, to the bibliography, literature checklist, related_work, comparator table, and gap prose strictly as a non-overlapping comparator. State precisely that it studies the vector counterfactual feature mu(X) through plug-in hierarchical linkages and density level sets; its Theorem 3.2 controls pruning/misclassification error under a good-neighborhood condition and Theorem 4.1 controls Hausdorff error of a smoothed-density level set. It does not define optimized k-means distortion W(K), normalized profile rho(K), adjacent gains G(K), corrected risk scores, simultaneous studentized bands, or a growing K_n frontier. Its multiple granularities are dendrogram levels, not coordinates of this adjacent-distortion profile, and its lack of a k-means margin condition comes from changing the clustering object. Note its stated future-work gap on efficient semiparametric estimators.

Do not label Theorem 1 a strict extension of the NeurIPS paper. Do not promote the current scalar squared-error k-means theorem to a generic causal-quantizer theorem: ordered centers, nearest-center maps, Voronoi boundaries, cell radii, distortion Hessians, the optimized-risk influence function, and the remainder gauges are all k-means-specific. Make the flagship theorem a matched upper-and-lower result. For the lower side, replace the single-coordinate +/- score tilt by a genuine multi-coordinate Le Cam chain, Fano packing, or Assouad hypercube over a covariance-separated subset J_n of resolutions. Construct the perturbations explicitly (orthogonalized/residualized score directions or localized regression/feature tilts), and prove normalization, positivity/overlap, bounded-feature support, optimizer stability/quadratic growth, margin control, and KL/Hellinger bounds uniformly over the whole hypercube. Do not claim sqrt(log K_n) unless the covariance packing actually yields it; if dependence yields sqrt(log |J_n|), sqrt(log log K_n), or another rate, report that rate.

Avoid comparator inflation. Treat Kim-Kim-Kennedy 2026 only as the source of the fixed-k EIF ingredients; treat Belloni/Chernozhukov/Chetverikov/Koike only as supplied-score approximation machinery; treat Levrard/Cai-Low only as lower-bound antecedents; and keep Kim-Kim-Wasserman-Kennedy 2024 as non-overlapping related work unless angle 1 genuinely defines and proves a theorem for their shared hierarchy/level-set object. If the effective packing is O(1), or every joint tilt destroys class membership/changes the target only through one effective direction, angle 1 cannot claim a simultaneous minimax penalty and must be killed rather than falling back to the coordinatewise theorem.

Retain the flagship matched covariance-aware theorem and repair the following definitions and receipts without changing its honest scope. Both the upper and lower matched claims remain over U_n only; the broader triangular class receives only uniform linearization.

1. Replace the ambiguous score centering and variance by raw foldwise values: define psi_tilde_{iK} as the cross-fitted plug-in score, psi_bar_K = n^{-1} sum_i psi_tilde_{iK}, Delta_phi_hat_{iK}=psi_tilde_{iK}-psi_bar_K, sigma_hat_K^2=n^{-1} sum_i (Delta_phi_hat_{iK})^2, and sigma_hat_K as its nonnegative square root.
